behavior: Given a path with no ancestor pom.xml, resolving that path always returns an explicit error whose message names the supplied path, never an empty successful result.
rationale: Managed versus unmanaged ancestry selects distinct routing outcomes, so a decision-table row for the no-ancestor-pom.xml branch directly exercises INV-ROUTE-2 and falsifies an implementation that returns an empty success or an error that omits the supplied path.
